description: This file defines a React component for managing user views in an admin dashboard, including user listing, editing, deletion, and resetting passwords. It imports various UI components, hooks, and networking utilities, and orchestrates data fetching, state management, and modal dialogs.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Sets the user to delete and opens the delete confirmation modal.

methods.name: useEffect fetchUserModels
methods.description: Fetches available user models for bulk editing when dependencies change.

methods.name: updateFilters
methods.description: Updates filter state with debounced behavior.

methods.name: handleSortChange
methods.description: Updates sorting parameters for user list.

methods.name: handleResetPassword
methods.description: Generates a password reset link for a user and opens a modal.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Calls API to delete a user and updates the user list.

methods.name: cancelDelete
methods.description: Closes the delete confirmation modal without action.

methods.name: handleEditSubmit
methods.description: Submits updated user info and updates the user list.

methods.name: handleToggleSelectionMode
methods.description: Enables or disables user selection mode.

methods.name: handleSelectionChange
methods.description: Updates selected users for bulk actions.

methods.name: handleBulkEdit
methods.description: Opens bulk edit modal for selected users.

methods.name: handleBulkEditSuccess
methods.description: Refetches user list after successful bulk edit.
